instruction: Lift the liquid container dark brown plastic as the other arm lifts the brown bottle.

source.instruction: Lift the liquid container dark brown plastic as the other arm lifts the brown bottle.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the bottle1, which was at x = -13 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the bottle2, which was at x = +15 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate and translate left arm toward the dark brown container around (-18, 0, 94).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+12, +18, -0) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the bottle1

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-18, -1, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm to z=87. Rotate and move right arm forward toward the brown bottle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -7) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +13 cm (vertical) from the bottle1; RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +11, -0) cm, now 23 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the bottle2

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-18, -1, 87) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -8, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right arm closer to the brown bottle at (20, 4, 89).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-10, +12, -5) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the bottle2

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-18, -1, 87) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, 4, 89) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Fine-adjust left arm forward and rightward to enclose the dark brown container.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+3, +2, +0) cm, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +13 cm (vertical) from the bottle1

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-15, 1, 87) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, 4, 89) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm further forward to center fingertips on the container.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+2, +4, +0) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +13 cm (vertical) from the bottle1

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, 5, 87) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, 4, 89) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Adjust left arm height slightly to settle grip.

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, 5, 87) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, 4, 89) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Shift right arm towards (18, 7, 89) to enclose the bottle.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-2, +3, +0) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the bottle2

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, 5, 87) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (18, 7, 89) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Advance right arm further to center around the brown bottle at (16, 9, 89).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-2, +3, +0) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the bottle2

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, 5, 87) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (16, 9, 90) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close both grippers firmly on the container and bottle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +13 cm (vertical) from the bottle1; RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the bottle2

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, 5, 87) opening 0.81; RIGHT fingertips (16, 10, 90) opening 0.84; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift both arms simultaneously by ~9 cm.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, 5, 96) opening 0.81; RIGHT fingertips (16, 10, 99) opening 0.86; table z = 74

frames.label: turn 12
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -11, 100) opening 0.81; RIGHT fingertips (16, 10, 99) opening 0.86; table z = 74
frames.plan: Retract right arm backward to match and complete the dual lift.
